already-running-many: {reserves} are already running. The workflow never stacks, it waits for that to expire, then re-activates if you are still in the window (so it starts later than {start} today).
already-running-one: {reserves} is already running. The workflow never stacks, it waits for that to expire, then re-activates if you are still in the window (so it starts later than {start} today).
minimum-online-must-be-between: Minimum online must be between 1 and 100.
session-expired: That Wargaming session expired, it needs a fresh login to keep running.
the-end-time-must-be: The end time must be after the start time. A window cannot run past midnight.
